"use client"

import * as React from "react"
import { Switch as SwitchPrimitive } from "@base-ui/react/switch"

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"
import type { WithClassName } from "./_shared"

/*
 * Playdesk Switch: a recessed slot when off, the primary Button's blue fill
 * when on. The thumb is a white cap sitting in the groove.
 */

const Switch = React.forwardRef<
  HTMLButtonElement,
  WithClassName<SwitchPrimitive.Root.Props>
>(({ className, ...props }, ref) => (
  <SwitchPrimitive.Root
    ref={ref}
    className={cn(
      "group/switch peer inline-flex h-6 w-11 shrink-0 cursor-pointer items-center rounded-full",
      "bg-secondary [box-shadow:var(--shadow-track-inset)]",
      "transition-[background-image,box-shadow] duration-base ease-out",
      "focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-[0.1875rem] focus-visible:ring-ring/35",
      "data-disabled:cursor-not-allowed data-disabled:opacity-50",
      "data-checked:[background-image:var(--fill-primary)] data-checked:[box-shadow:var(--shadow-primary)]",
      className
    )}
    {...props}
  >
    <SwitchPrimitive.Thumb
      className={cn(
        "pointer-events-none block size-5 rounded-full bg-card",
        "[box-shadow:0_0.0625rem_0.1875rem_oklch(0_0_0_/_0.25)]",
        "data-checked:translate-x-[1.375rem] data-unchecked:translate-x-0.5",
        "origin-left data-checked:origin-right rtl:origin-right rtl:data-checked:origin-left transition-[translate,scale,transform-origin,background-color,box-shadow] duration-[260ms,140ms,0ms,150ms,150ms] delay-[0ms,0ms,140ms,0ms,0ms] ease-out motion-safe:group-active/switch:scale-x-[1.18] motion-reduce:transition-none"
      )}
    />
  </SwitchPrimitive.Root>
))
Switch.displayName = "Switch"

export { Switch }
